findings.title: Plugin health monitoring & automatic restart
findings.claim_text: [x] Plugin health monitoring and automatic restart (Issue: #2373)
findings.expected: Plugins are automatically restarted after a health-check failure (watchdog mechanism).
findings.observed: Health-check infrastructure exists in module_loader.cpp (healthChecks_ map, runHealthChecks(), lines 452–1178). Checks run at module activation stage. No automatic restart mechanism found in any base source file (no restart_count, watchdog, or auto_recover symbol in module_loader.cpp, hot_reload_manager.cpp, or module_sandbox.cpp).

evidence.detail: healthChecks_ map; activation stage lines 452–476; runHealthChecks() lines 1148–1190
registerHealthCheck() API present; no restart API

findings.issue_title_suggestion: feat(base): implement automatic plugin restart on health-check failure

findings.title: WASM-based plugin isolation — WasmRuntime injection required
findings.claim_text: [x] WASM-based plugin isolation for untrusted code (Issue: #1572)
findings.expected: Fully functional WASM isolation for untrusted plugins, operational without additional setup.
findings.observed: WasmPluginSandbox infrastructure is fully implemented. setRuntime(std::unique_ptr<WasmRuntime>) must be called before callExport(); without injection, callExport() fails with 'inject a WasmRuntime before calling callExport()' (wasm_plugin_sandbox.cpp line 457). No concrete WasmRuntime implementation (Wasmtime, WasmEdge) found in the repository.

evidence.detail: setRuntime() at line 288; error message at line 457
WasmRuntime abstract interface defined; no concrete implementation

findings.issue_title_suggestion: feat(base): integrate concrete WasmRuntime (Wasmtime or WasmEdge) into WasmPluginSandbox

findings.title: Signed plugin repository — public-key pinning missing
findings.claim_text: [x] Signed plugin repository with key pinning
findings.expected: The remote plugin registry's public key is pinned in server configuration; downloads are verified against this fixed key independent of CA trust.
findings.observed: RegistryConfig in remote_registry_client.h has verify_ssl = true (CA-based TLS cert verification). No pinned_pubkey, cert_pin, or pubkey_fingerprint field found in remote_registry_client.h or remote_registry_client.cpp.

evidence.detail: RegistryConfig::verify_ssl at line 71; no pin_* field

findings.issue_title_suggestion: feat(base): implement public-key pinning for remote plugin registry

findings.title: Runtime plugin capability negotiation (version ranges) — not enforced
findings.expected: Plugins actively negotiate version compatibility at runtime.
findings.observed: PluginDependencyGraph stores minVersion/maxVersion per dependency edge (plugin_dependency_graph.h lines 109–110). No negotiate(), checkCompatibility(), or similar enforcement method found in plugin_dependency_graph.h/.cpp or module_loader.h/.cpp. Version ranges are declared and shown in DOT visualization but not enforced at runtime. Actual enforcement is part of Issue #1566.

evidence.detail: Edge::minVersion/maxVersion at lines 109–110; no negotiation method

findings.issue_title_suggestion: feat(base): implement runtime version compatibility enforcement in PluginDependencyGraph (part of #1566)
